hypothesis_text: A single 100-round run of Gemma 4 vs. mirror-LLM produced a cooperation rate of 0.98, establishing that self-play between identical LLM instances reliably converges to cooperation.
flaw_description: n=1 run, no seeds, no replication. 'Reliably converges' is unsupported by a single trajectory. At minimum a half-dozen seeds are needed before claiming convergence; a single trajectory cannot distinguish a deterministic attractor from a lucky path.
expected_critique_targets: single run is not evidence for reliable convergence
no variance estimate possible from n=1
context: exp001 mirror_llm condition was run once with temperature 0.0.
